text:
Rae (Marketing): Quick thread - new launch blog hero + bench stat + gated webinar CTA. Need legal + sales signoff to lock for Tues publish.

Rae (Marketing): Hero draft: "Launch LLM features with predictable sub-150ms 95th-percentile latency (prompts <=512 tokens) and up to 3x lower estimated serving costs in our internal benchmark."
Bench pullout: "Internal test: batching + KV cache reduced median token cost by up to 3x (see methodology)."
CTA block: gated webinar form (HubSpot) + HubSpot hidden fields.

Liam (Sales): Request: tag blog leads with hidden `account_size` and default `account_size=enterprise` for high-intent flows. Also add `source_detail=blog_launch` so SDRs can filter.

Priya (Product): Can we be explicit on prompt length in the hero? that helps customers. Otherwise fine.

Noah (Legal): Change "up to 3x lower" -> "reduces estimated serving costs by up to 3x in our internal benchmark (methodology link)". We need the methodology link and a short footnote. Then I can sign off.

Sana (Growth): Add hidden fields: `account_size, company_size, region, pql_score, lead_tier`. Set `lead_tier=marketing_high` for webinar signups. Recommend A/B: variant A gated form, variant B instant CTA. Add `utm_content=hero_cta_v1/v2`.

Liam (Sales): Also please route enterprise leads to `#sales-inbound` and trigger webhook `sales_alerts`.

Rae (Marketing): Will implement: hidden fields + notify mapping for enterprise -> `#sales-inbound` + webhook. Add methodology link footnote. Create A/B CTAs with utm tags.

Noah (Legal): Approved with the wording change and methodology link.

Priya (Product): Approved—I attached the mini bench graph for the pullout.

Sana (Growth): I'll set the 50/50 split for 72 hours and track MQL -> attendance. Will post experiment link.

PublishBot: Created publish job pub_20260416_0900 status=pending_final_copy.

Rae (Marketing): Thanks — locking copy now. Final ask: please react with "ok" by 3pm PT so I can schedule.

Liam (Sales): ok

Noah (Legal): ok

Priya (Product): ok

Sana (Growth): ok :rocket:

Rae (Marketing): Locked and will post final draft & publish window in 15 mins. :memo:
